status: work-in-progress; not an approved sprite atlas

sourceRoute: One editable textured 3D wizard rig + authored motions; six school-controlled material/staff variations of that SAME rig; atlas export per school

stageB.description: Editable sculpt, UV textures, weighted body/beard/robes, six staff meshes and clean silhouette checks

stageC.description: One true looped 16-frame walk in South direction, planted feet, sway/hand contact, mobile Sprite Lab review

stageD.description: Eight unique directions; idle, walk, cast, hurt, death; six variants derived from same animation rig

stageE.description: Pose-aligned authored normals, height/occluder, roughness, caster and real shared LitSprite test on PR #332

constraints: Do not alter Hollowed or Ashling.
Do not replace current arena-mage.js until visual/technical/mobile approval.
